question:
The following change is made to `staging/src/k8s.io/code-generator/cmd/validation-gen/validators/validators.go`:

A new method `IsLate() bool` is added to the `TagValidator` interface. All concrete types that satisfy `TagValidator` must now implement this method.

Which files within the `kubernetes/kubernetes` repository would fail to compile or exhibit a runtime regression as a result of this change? List each file by its path relative to the repository root.

change.before:
type TagValidator interface {
	Init(cfg Config)
	TagName() string
	ValidScopes() sets.Set[Scope]
	GetValidations(context Context, tag codetags.Tag) (Validations, error)
	Docs() TagDoc
}
change.after:
type TagValidator interface {
	Init(cfg Config)
	TagName() string
	ValidScopes() sets.Set[Scope]
	GetValidations(context Context, tag codetags.Tag) (Validations, error)
	Docs() TagDoc
	IsLate() bool
}
change.description: IsLate() bool is added as a new required method on the TagValidator interface. Every concrete struct that implements TagValidator must now also implement IsLate() bool or the Go compiler will reject it as not satisfying the interface. There are 18 files in the validators package that each define one or more concrete TagValidator implementations and register them via RegisterTagValidator. All 18 fail to compile until each implements the new method. validators.go (the definition file) and registry.go (which stores/calls TagValidator but does not implement it) are not impacted.

breaking_patterns.why_breaks: IsLate() bool added to TagValidator interface; every concrete implementor that does not define this method no longer satisfies the interface, causing a compile error wherever the concrete type is passed as a TagValidator (e.g., to RegisterTagValidator).
breaking_patterns.example: RegisterTagValidator(&discriminatorTagValidator{...}) — discriminatorTagValidator does not have IsLate() bool

impacted_files.suggested_fix: Add 'func (v *discriminatorTagValidator) IsLate() bool { return false }' and 'func (v *memberTagValidator) IsLate() bool { return false }' to discriminator.go.
Add IsLate() bool to the each tag validator struct(s) defined in each.go.
Add IsLate() bool to enumTagValidator and enumExcludeTagValidator structs in enum.go.
Add 'func (v neqTagValidator) IsLate() bool { return false }' to equality.go.
Add IsLate() bool to formatTagValidator in format.go.
Add IsLate() bool to immutableTagValidator in immutable.go.
Add IsLate() bool to itemTagValidator in item.go.
Add IsLate() bool to levelTagValidator in levels.go.
Add IsLate() bool to maxItemsTagValidator, minimumTagValidator, and maxLengthTagValidator in limits.go.
Add IsLate() bool to listTypeTagValidator, listMapKeyTagValidator, uniqueTagValidator, and customUniqueTagValidator in list.go.
Add IsLate() bool to opaqueTypeTagValidator in opaque.go.
Add IsLate() bool to ifTagValidator in options.go.
Add IsLate() bool to requirednessTagValidator in required.go.
Add IsLate() bool to subfieldTagValidator in subfield.go.
Add IsLate() bool to fixedResultTagValidator in testing.go.
Add IsLate() bool to unionDiscriminatorTagValidator and unionMemberTagValidator in union.go.
Add IsLate() bool to updateTagCollector in update.go.
